_why: A red suite that is 'normal' is how a real regression hides. These are the failures AND errors we have accepted, by exact node id, with the reason each is out of our control. Anything failing or erroring that is not listed here is NEW and blocks the doorbell. Anything listed here that now passes must be removed - a baseline that only ever grows is a place to hide. ERROR-class outcomes are listed because the first version parsed only FAILED lines, so the 5 collection errors were invisible to a guard that claimed to catch any unlisted failure: a stated claim exceeding its mechanism.

membukkit_run_provenance.why: These assert on artifacts from real recorded runs - device_proof, an empty load_trace.downloads. The engine itself is present: vendor/membukkit/src is on the path, the repo's own copy pinned to f28a2e58 with blob SHAs verified upstream. No path or install can satisfy these; only a recorded run can.

frozen_source_drift_after_gen123.why: Gen123's review found the freshness gate in scripts/run_gen118_freeze.py could not see words already shown to the reader (the 'platform' miss: gen110/gen114 store stimulus text in reader_requests.jsonl, which the old glob never read). Fixing it edited a file the attempt19 contract pins by hash, so preflight now correctly reports FROZEN SOURCE CHANGED. This is the apparatus telling the truth: attempt19 is sealed and spent, and the repaired gate belongs to the NEXT freeze, not a re-run of this one. It cannot be cleared by re-freezing fixture 2 - the repaired gate itself (correctly) refuses, because Gen123 exposed fixture 2's words.
frozen_source_drift_after_gen123.clears_when: A new fixture is frozen (attempt20). At that point the contract pins the edited scripts/run_gen118_freeze.py and all three go green on their own. If they are still failing after the next freeze, that is NEW and must be investigated, not re-pinned.
